description.en:
Subscription type.

- PartnerBillingItemDetailForBillingPeriod: Billing item bill details.
- PartnerBillingItemDetailMonthly: Billing item monthly bill.
- PartnerInstanceDetailForBillingPeriod: Instance bill details.
- PartnerInstanceDetailMonthly: Instance monthly bill.

title.zh: 取消订阅多级分销账单

descriptions.zh:
请确保调用者是国际阿里云总经销商伙伴。

用户一次可取消订阅一个类型的账单文件

对应账单类型被取消后,不再推送文件到指定oss空间

**本内容只发布国际站**
descriptions.en:
Make sure that the caller is an international Alibaba Cloud master reseller partner.

You can unsubscribe from one type of bill file at a time.

After the corresponding bill type is unsubscribed, files are no longer pushed to the specified OSS space.

**This content is published only on the international site.**
